lesson: Do not guess Gutenberg IDs. Search the index, then verify the downloaded file's Title line.
what: Four of five Gutenberg IDs guessed from memory returned entirely different books
found: 48911 is F. W. Bain's 'A Mine of Faults' (1910), not West African Folk-Tales; 38238 is 'The Old Yellow Book'; 6338 is 'Boy Scouts in the Coal Caverns'; 40453 is 'Tom Ossington's Ghost'. All four were downloaded under plausible filenames and all four were wrong.
action: Deleted. The GUTINDEX.ALL master index was downloaded and searched, and every ID re-derived from it. Correct IDs: West African Folk-Tales 66923, Jamaica Anansi Stories 72735, The Turkish Jester 16244, Journey to the West 23962, Reynard in South Africa 73413.

lesson: Check the Language: line, not just the title.
what: Journey to the West downloaded in Chinese
found: Gutenberg 23962 is the original 西遊記, not a translation. 11% ASCII.
action: Marked REJECTED FOR USE. Sun Wukong is reachable in English through Werner's Myths and Legends of China, already held.

lesson: A fetch that returns HTTP 200 can still be an error page. Check the content type, not the status code.
what: An Internet Archive error page is sitting in the UES-01 source library
found: UES-01/01_SOURCE/primary/mar12-egyptian.txt is 134 KB of HTML titled 'Internet Archive: Page Not Found', listed in the UES-01 file inventory.
action: No UES-01 story cites it and it is not claimed as a verified source, so no shipped text is affected. Flagged for deletion. Do not reuse it for UES-02.
